cell_observations.confidence_notes: Signals repeat across the board; exact subject and room should not transfer.

STYLE_DNA.core_visual_identity: A low-saturation analog photographic style with cyan-green shadows, milky highlights, soft focus drift, and emotionally distant off-center framing.
STYLE_DNA.emotion_and_atmosphere: Restrained emotional distance and humid memory-fragment atmosphere built through low expression intensity, negative space, cyan-green shadows, and milky soft focus.

locked_style.palette: low-saturation cyan-green shadows with faded neutral midtones
locked_style.lighting: diffused soft light with milky overexposed highlights
locked_style.texture: analog grain, mild compression artifacts, imperfect focus drift

strong_style.composition: off-center subject placement with negative space
strong_style.camera: natural eye-level or slightly lowered camera, non-commercial framing

photographic.exposure_behavior: soft overexposure without clean HDR clarity
